body: Tighten the light-depth probe so it actually requires plant growth, not just 'less negative growth'. The only semantic check is `growth_shallow > growth_deep` in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:627-657`. On the current test run that passes with both values negative (`shallow=-0.4029 g`, `deep=-0.7110 g`), so the probe reports success even though neither tank experienced the documented 'more plant biomass growth after 14 days'.
